release_notes: Tachyon AIO v0.45.17 corrects the Top/Classic owner header group so Owner Vault and Announcements are truly centered on the full application header. The previous layout still inherited legacy CSS Grid column placement, which caused the absolutely positioned center group to calculate its 50% position from the middle grid cell and appear shifted to the right. This release clears that legacy grid placement while preserving the existing matched card sizes, spacing, announcement popover behavior, protected broadcasts.write authority, and Sidebar layout. Regression coverage now locks the full-header containing block contract. The exact PR head passed Architecture Guard, Linux Release Preflight, Windows Consumer E2E, and CodeQL before merge and Stable promotion.
